assertions:
  - assertionId: assert.transfer.settled
    description: Verify transfer is SETTLED with full evidence chain
    endpoint: /internal/test-support/v1/assertions/payments/{paymentId}
    checks:
      - path: transfer.status
        equals: SETTLED
      - path: stateHistory
        minItems: 3
      - path: outbox
        minItems: 1
      - path: auditCount
        gte: 1

  - assertionId: assert.transfer.failed
    description: Verify transfer is FAILED with failure reason
    endpoint: /internal/test-support/v1/assertions/payments/{paymentId}
    checks:
      - path: transfer.status
        equals: FAILED

  - assertionId: assert.transfer.reversed
    description: Verify transfer is REVERSED after reversal approval
    endpoint: /internal/test-support/v1/assertions/payments/{paymentId}
    checks:
      - path: transfer.status
        equals: REVERSED
      - path: stateHistory
        minItems: 5

  - assertionId: assert.ledger.balanced
    description: Verify ledger debit equals credit
    endpoint: /internal/test-support/v1/assertions/ledger/{correlationId}
    checks:
      - path: entries
        minItems: 2

  - assertionId: assert.reconciliation.matched
    description: Verify reconciliation has zero differences
    endpoint: /internal/test-support/v1/assertions/reconciliation/{correlationId}
    checks:
      - path: runs[0].status
        equals: MATCHED
      - path: runs[0].differences
        equals: 0
